forest_research_canopy.name: UK Ward Canopy Cover
forest_research_canopy.cadence: One point per ward, NOT a single "2020" survey as previously assumed (corrected 2026-09-29, P2.3/ADR-0006) -- this is citizen-science i-Tree Canopy data collected ward-by-ward between 2018 and 2022, each ward carrying its own `survyear` field. Cholsey ward's own record was surveyed in 2021.
forest_research_canopy.attribution_text: Contains, or is based on, information supplied by the Forestry Commission. © Crown copyright and database right, Ordnance Survey AC0000814847.
forest_research_canopy.notes: Ward, not parish — needs area-weighted reallocation to Cholsey's parish polygon (spec §4). No cross-year trend for a single ward (plan risk R2) -- each ward has exactly one survey point (Cholsey's: 2021), not a repeatable annual series. REAL FINDING (P2.3/ADR-0006, 2026-09-29): this dataset's "Cholsey" ward record uses wardcode E05009737 (the December 2018 ward edition), NOT E05011701 (the current, Dec 2020 edition confirmed in P1.1/P1.2) -- South Oxfordshire's wards were recoded/redrawn between those vintages. Verified the two boundaries are still a near-exact geometric match for Cholsey specifically (parish is 99.4% within the old ward vs 100.0% within the new one, a difference too small to matter) -- so P1.5's existing ward-weight row (1.0, using E05011701) stands uncorrected, but this was luck, not something the original "working assumption" had actually verified. Q-008 evaluated UKCEH's Land Cover Map as an alternative (ADR-0006): decided to keep this dataset as metric 1's primary source (it measures canopy % directly, matching spec's metric definition) and treat UKCEH LCM as a separate, documented stretch/trend metric instead of conflating two non-equivalent measurements into one.

desnz_regional_la_energy.name: Regional and local authority electricity/gas consumption statistics
desnz_regional_la_energy.attribution_text: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
desnz_regional_la_energy.notes: REAL FINDING (P2.5, 2026-09-29): development-plan.md's P2.5 wording ("plus district and national totals from the same release") suggested the LSOA-level file (desnz_lsoa_energy) also carried district/national totals. It doesn't -- those come from this genuinely separate GOV.UK publication (found via the GOV.UK site search API, part of the same "sub-national electricity consumption data" collection, but its own release with its own landing page and its own current-year asset link). Each year's sheet has one row per local authority, plus "All local authorities" rows giving region/country totals (including England, E92000001, and Great Britain) -- both South Oxfordshire (E07000179) and England were verified live: 2023 domestic consumption 272.26 GWh and 83,110.58 GWh respectively. REAL FINDING (P3.4, 2026-09-30): gas's sheet has a genuinely different column layout than electricity's (an extra "Notes" column, no Standard/E7 meter split, header one row lower) -- P2.5 only verified electricity live. Fixed in fetch/desnz_lsoa_energy.py with per-fuel header row/column lookups; 2024 domestic consumption verified live: South Oxfordshire 677.02 GWh, England 242,971.93 GWh (gas).
desnz_regional_la_energy.discovery_rule: Same hash-URL-changes-on-release caveat as desnz_lsoa_energy above -- fetch_current_download_url() re-scrapes the landing page each run.

mcs_installations.name: MCS Data Dashboard / installation data
mcs_installations.resolution: local authority (South Oxfordshire) — the dashboard's own selectable geography filter; no parish-level export found, see ADR-0007's Resolution section
mcs_installations.cadence: continuously updated on the dashboard; this project's copy is a manual snapshot (2026-09-30), re-pulled by hand when a refresh is wanted — no bulk API
mcs_installations.format: per-chart CSV export (manual browser download), committed as reference data
mcs_installations.licence: TBD — confirm licence/terms before bulk use
mcs_installations.attribution_text: Data from the MCS Data Dashboard (Microgeneration Certification Scheme).
mcs_installations.notes: Covers MCS-certified installs only — undercounts pre-2008 or non-certified installs. Real finding (P2.7, 2026-09-30, ADR-0007): no self-service bulk/postcode download exists on the dashboard — only per-chart CSV exports, filtered to whatever geography the dashboard's own UI offers. Resolved via Q-011 (STATUS.md, answered 2026-09-30): Tom manually retrieved South Oxfordshire's real MCS figures (heat pump and solar PV) via the dashboard's own export, committed as reference data (`fetch/reference_data/mcs_installations/`, see its `_provenance.json` for full retrieval details and two real gaps: no installed-kWp field, and whether a finer-than-LA geography filter exists on the dashboard was not verified). See ADR-0007's Resolution section for the fallbacks originally considered (DESNZ BUS ad-hoc releases, Ofgem FIT) and why this manual MCS retrieval is a better real-data outcome than any of them.
mcs_installations.discovery_rule: No discovery needed — there is no bulk endpoint to discover. A refresh means repeating the dashboard's manual per-chart export (see `_provenance.json`), not re-running a URL-scraping fetcher.
mcs_installations.fetcher: fetch/mcs_installations.py (P2.7, done 2026-09-30, ADR-0007/Q-011 — loads committed reference data, no live fetch)

os_open_greenspace.name: OS Open Greenspace
os_open_greenspace.attribution_text: Contains OS data (c) Crown copyright and database right, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
os_open_greenspace.notes: Free, OGL-licensed. No canopy attribute, only greenspace type — which function types count as "accessible green space" for metric 2 is decided in ADR-0008 (P3.3), not repeated here. Two layers: `greenspace_site` (polygons, what the fetcher reads) and `access_point` (points, not currently used). GB-wide file is clipped to a 500m-buffered bbox around Cholsey + comparators on ingest (read directly out of the downloaded zip via GDAL's zip:// URI, no separate extraction step) so the interim extract stays small, per P2.4.

desnz_lsoa_energy.name: Sub-national electricity and gas consumption (LSOA/MSOA)
desnz_lsoa_energy.attribution_text: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
desnz_lsoa_energy.notes: LSOA figures are domestic-only; MSOA also has non-domestic consumption.
desnz_lsoa_energy.discovery_rule: These asset URLs (assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/<hash>/...) change on every annual release, so fetch/desnz_lsoa_energy.py's fetch_current_download_url() re-scrapes the landing page for the current link each run rather than trusting the hash above -- the values here are just the snapshot found live 2026-09-29 (P2.1/P2.5), for reference/fallback.
